blocks.text:
The `Gtk::DragSource` and `Gtk::DropTarget`
event controllers have methods and signals which are used for Drag and Drop.
blocks.zh: `Gtk::DragSource` 和 `Gtk::DropTarget` 事件控制器提供了用于拖放的方法和信号。

blocks.text:
Things are dragged from `sources` to be dropped on
`targets`. Each source and target has information
about the data formats that it can send or receive, provided by
`Gdk::ContentFormats`. A drop target will only
accept a dragged item if they both share a compatible format. Appropriate
signals will then be emitted, telling the signal handlers which format was used.
blocks.zh: 东西从 *源（source）* 被拖到 *目标（target）* 上放下。每个源和目标都带有它能发送或接收的数据格式的信息，由 `Gdk::ContentFormats` 提供。只有当被拖动的项与放置目标有共同的兼容格式时，放置目标才会接受它。然后会发出相应的信号，告诉信号处理函数用的是哪种格式。

blocks.text:
`Gdk::ContentFormats` objects contain information about
available `GType`s and mime types (media types).
blocks.zh: Gdk::ContentFormats对象包含了可用的GType和MIME类型（媒体类型）的相关信息。
